title: Halting after the extractor rewind phase
statement: Let $first,second$ be Boolean flags and let $x,pre,rest,a$ be Boolean words with $x=pre\mathbin{++}rest$. Starting in the pair extractor's rewind state at input position $|pre|$, with buffer $a$, work head at $|a|-1$, and empty output, there is a time $t\le 2|a|+|rest|+3$ at which the machine is halted and its output is $(a\text{ if }first\text{ is true, otherwise empty})$ followed by $(rest\text{ if }second\text{ is true, otherwise empty})$.
hypotheses_covered: first and second are Boolean flags
x, pre, rest, and a are Boolean words
replaced:
For a split $x = p s$ of the input and a validated buffer $a$, there is a time
$t \le 2\abs{a} + \abs{s} + 3$ such that after $t$ steps from the start of the
rewind phase at position $\abs{p}$ the extractor has halted, and its output is
$a$ (when the first flag is set) followed by $s$ (when the second flag is
set).
